description: Metadata pointer from a file row to its binary payload in internal CAS storage.

id.description: File primary-key value (matches lix_file.id) for this binary reference row.

blob_hash.description: BLAKE3 content hash used as the canonical CAS key for the binary payload.

size_bytes.description: Logical uncompressed file size in bytes for the referenced binary payload.

plugin_arena_hash.description: Optional CAS hash of the canonical v3.2 immutable arena archive.

plugin_arena_root.description: Optional v3.2 arena root digest authenticated by plugin_arena_hash.

plugin_generation.description: Installed plugin archive generation that owns the arena root.
